notes: MCU module (controller domain); SPI2/FSPI IO_MUX pins GPIO10-13 drive the isolator - IO_MUX avoids the GPIO-matrix delay
3V3_A LDO 600mA (controller domain). NOT usable on the isolated rail: 6V abs max vs 6.33V worst case there

4-ch digital isolator, 3 forward + 1 reverse = a 4-wire SPI master port. NON-F VARIANT REQUIRED: default output HIGH keeps CS# deasserted when either side loses power. ISO7741DW (tube) is Obsolete/0 stock - order the DWR reel part

3V3_ISO post-regulator. Chosen for 18V abs max Vin (the unregulated isolated rail reaches 6.68V at no load). SOT-223 pinout is 1=VIN 2=GND 3=VOUT - CONFIRM PINOUT before ANY substitution; NCP1117/AMS1117-class SOT-223 parts are reversed
12-bit 8-channel SPI ADC on the isolated side; CH4-CH7 tied to GND_ISO (no floating analog inputs)
VBUS + D+/D- ESD array; UMW is a pin/spec second source

1W isolated DC-DC 5V/5V, UNREGULATED, 20-70kHz. SETS THE BOARD'S ISOLATION RATING: functional grade, 1kVDC/1s, 500VAC/1min, 75pF barrier capacitance. No substitution without re-running the isolation review (design.md section 9)
PTC polyfuse 1.5A hold / 3.0A trip, R1max 110mR. Replaces the L1.01 1206L050YR, whose 700mR post-trip resistance would drop PS1's input below its 4.5V minimum
USB-C receptacle; right-angle SMT contacts with THT solder-retention posts

Breakaway header snapped to 1x6 (J2 isolated analog) + 1x6 (J3 isolated SPI) + 1x2 (JP1 ADC select). Quantity is the placement count; ONE 1x40 strip physically covers all three (14 of 40 pins) - buy 1
Shunt jumper for JP1. Fitted = on-board ADC is on the isolated bus; removed = an external device on J3 owns the bus (R8 holds the ADC deselected)
100uH pi-filter inductor; DCR 456mR max, Irms 920mA, Isat 1.33A. Sets the 1.07kHz filter corner with C11
220uF 16V radial electrolytic - pi-filter bulk. ELECTROLYTIC ON PURPOSE: no DC-bias derating (so the filter math holds) and its 130mR ESR damps the LC to Q=1.15. A ceramic bank would fail both
10uF 25V X5R. C1 = 3V3_A bulk; C8+C9 = PS1 input decoupling (2x parallel); C10 = V_ISO_RAW local reservoir
1uF. C5/C6 = RT9080 in/out; C12/C13 = MCP1703A in/out; C16 = MCP3208 VREF
0.1uF. C2/C3 = WROOM decoupling; C4 = EN cap; C7 = ISO7741 VCC1; C14 = ISO7741 VCC2; C15 = MCP3208 VDD
10k. R1 = EN pull-up; R2 = BOOT pull-up; R8 = MCP3208 CS# pull-up (holds the ADC deselected when JP1 is open)
5.1k USB-C CC1/CC2 sink pull-downs
1k series on every isolated header pin: R9-R12 on J3 (SPI), R13-R16 on J2 (analog). NOT the catalog 10k - 10k would break 12-bit ADC settling inside the 1.5us sample window
470R LED series: R5 = 3V3_A power LED; R6 = SCAN LED on GPIO47; R17 = 3V3_ISO power LED
330R preload on V_ISO_RAW - holds PS1 above its 10% minimum load so its datasheet regulation figures apply. 1206 not 0805: 109mW would be 87% of an 0805's rating
Red - 3V3_A power LED (controller domain). Red not green: green Vf ~3.2V will not light on a 3.3V rail
Yellow. LED2 = SCAN activity on GPIO47 (controller domain); LED3 = 3V3_ISO power LED (isolated domain) - one power LED per domain is deliberate
EN (reset) / BOOT tactile, THT
Red test points: TP1 = 3V3_A; TP3 = V_ISO_RAW (before regulation); TP4 = 3V3_ISO (after). TP3/TP4 are how the learner SEES the post-regulation working
Black test points: TP2 = GND_A; TP5 = GND_ISO. LABEL BY DOMAIN - an earthed oscilloscope ground clip on GND_ISO shorts the isolation barrier through the scope
